name: Prompt Engineering: Handoffly
subtitle: Prompts, checks, hand-offs
shortDescription: Learn to get real work done with AI tools: break tasks into steps, write structured prompts, check outputs, prove the time saved, and hand the workflow over.
longDescription:
Handoffly is a hands-on course in getting real work done with AI tools, built for working adults. You do not read about it: you try ten everyday work scenarios, change the numbers, and see what happens.

WHAT YOU PRACTISE
- Break a job into steps and decide what a person, an assistant or a simple rule should do.
- Write structured prompts with six slots and score them against a clear rubric.
- Check outputs against a schema: required fields, types, the first violation.
- Ground answers in your own documents: pick the right passages, tag each sentence against its evidence, watch the input window budget.
- Iterate with a stopping rule, and audit the assumptions behind an answer.
- Recompute an AI table summary and read small samples with a confidence interval.
- Test a workflow on a small set of cases: pass rate, the rule of three for zero failures, did the change help.
- Wire an automation with an approval gate, see how injected instructions slip through, and cap an agent loop.
- Prove the value: net minutes saved after checking and fixing time, break-even, and where the saving disappears.
- Hand it off: a workflow card, versions, and a review clock.

HOW IT WORKS
Every lab is a small simulation of a work scenario. Move a slider or tap a step and the numbers change. Then an equation appears as the description of what you just saw: tap each symbol to see what it means in the scenario. Each lab ends with one question computed from what you built, and short checkpoint rounds explain every answer.

The Toolkit tab turns every lab into a calculator you can use on your own numbers.

SOURCES YOU CAN OPEN
Every card, equation and lab cites its sources: papers, standards bodies and university course pages. Tap a source and it opens in a sheet inside the app. All scenarios and figures are fictional and illustrative. We name only generic tool categories, never brands.

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
- Works offline. No account. No server of ours.
- Text size A- and A+ from 85 to 200 percent.
- Ads appear only at natural breaks, never during a lab or a quiz.
- Optional subscription "Ad-Free Monthly" removes ads only: $3.99 per month after a 7-day free trial. Cancel anytime in your account settings; cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle.

Handoffly is general education for adults (18+). It is not legal, medical, financial or professional advice. No outside expert has reviewed this app; every number is computed by code we verified against an independent calculation, and explanations are checked against the listed sources. Content as of 2026-11-17.

Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are available inside the app under More.
